name: Find your fit
layout: Lower section white background with generous 32px spacing. Left 60% a single elegant lightly rose-tinted 'Build your college shortlist' panel. Right40% a white 'Need a little direction?' panel without heavy border, two editorial horizontal actionable rows with small refined line icon, title and short explanation: 'Compare your options' / 'See fees, courses and campus details side by side.'; 'Explore career paths' / 'Understand which courses fit your interests.' At bottom a slim full-width resource strip labelled 'Explore exam guides' with JEE Main, NEET, CUET, CAT as neat textual links, and small Scholarship guide link. Balanced useful UI, not repeated box grid.

name: Choose your next step
layout: Replace lower section with spacious white background. Section title 'Where would you like to begin?' small subtext 'A clear next step for every stage of your journey.'
